methodology: Conservative positive POS-and-sense guards for already existing native editorial level anchors. English gloss only disambiguates the sense; no English CEFR level is consulted. A failed guard means use the ordinary multifactor estimate, never delete the word or force an advanced level. A guard absent from this mapping is NOT positively validated. CC-CEDICT unknown POS is accepted only together with a specific matching lexical sense. Technical/register tags must also be considered; e.g. Japanese work/physics is not ordinary employment.
